query: What booking links can VoyageFlow generate?
answer_markdown: VoyageFlow generates structured booking links, which are deep-linked search URLs [voyageflow-overview::003]. These include a hotel search link pre-filled with destination, check-in date, check-out date, and guest count [voyageflow-overview::003]. It also generates a flight search link pre-filled with origin airport, destination airport, and travel dates [voyageflow-overview::003]. When relevant, an activities/experiences link (via GetYourGuide or Viator) is also generated [voyageflow-overview::003]. Users must complete their reservation on the destination platform [voyageflow-overview::003]. VoyageFlow supports partners like Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda for hotels and Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak for flights [voyageflow-overview::002].
